GomeBoy 1.3.1 fixes a link-cable scheduler corruption that can hang emulation when a game re-arms the serial control register while a transfer is still pending.

## Link-cable fix

Pokémon Red's Cable Club can rewrite `SC` every frame while an internal- or external-clock transfer is still queued. GomeBoy's scheduler keeps one pooled node per event type, so scheduling the same serial event again without first removing the pending node could link that node into the event list twice. The next scheduler walk could then loop forever, causing `StepFrame()` to hang.

The serial controller now deschedules any pending `SerialBitTransfer` and `SerialExternalClock` event before re-arming the transfer. Regression coverage exercises both clock modes and verifies the scheduler remains finite.

This complements the external-clock starvation fix shipped in v1.3.0 and specifically addresses repeated Cable Club re-arming.

## What's Changed

* fix(serial): deschedule pending serial events before re-arming SC in https://github.com/maestroi/gomeboy/pull/44

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/maestroi/gomeboy/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1
